component.name: Loofi Pulse
Loofi Pulse
component.summary: Hardware, temperature, memory pressure, and power monitor for KDE Plasma 6
Hårdvaru-, temperatur-, minnestrycks- och effektövervakare för KDE Plasma 6

description.p: Loofi Pulse provides a KDE Plasma 6 panel applet and a Kirigami desktop application for viewing system hardware readings, temperatures, Linux memory and I/O pressure, power, and recent telemetry history. A shared collector supports the application and widget. Inspect processes and individual devices, investigate incidents, and explicitly save and reopen local sessions. Background monitoring is optional. Available readings depend on the sensors and interfaces exposed by the running Linux system.

Standalone dedicated pages for Graphics (GPU), Battery, Sensors, and Power Profiles with custom telemetry cards and hwmon integration; logical left navigation restructuring with separate pinned Settings action; application language preference supporting English as primary default, Swedish, and system locale; restored and expanded About and Documentation hub; brand-new high-resolution documentation branding and comprehensive guides.

Comprehensive UX/UI modernization and genuine hardware telemetry integration: 5 core overview pillars (CPU, Memory, PSI, GPU, Power & Battery), zero placeholder values, dynamic dual-line activity chart, compact and focused Plasma 6 widget popup with consolidated incident controls, dynamic host system detection, and grouped incident history clustering repeated episodes.

Comprehensive UX/UI simplification and KDE-native Breeze/Kirigami overhaul: simplified 4-section navigation with Kirigami.GlobalDrawer, clean KDE System Monitor-style overview, consolidated Hardware Monitor subtabs, split unit charts in Flight Recorder, lightweight Plasma 6 widget popup without animations or glowing halos, true Linux PSI stall metrics, and removal of AI-slop visual clutter.

Complete UI/UX redesign: premium KDE-native design system with new ECG wave branding, shared GPU-accelerated QML components (PulseTheme, PulseCard, PulseAreaChart, PulseRingGauge, HealthHero, MetricCard, FindingRow, DeviceCard), responsive sidebar navigation, redesigned overview dashboard, standardized hardware detail views, and upgraded Plasma widget.

Diagnostic certainty and telemetry freshness improvements; corrected and asynchronous incident kernel-log correlation; more informative privacy-preserving reports; activity-aware collector polling; and support for reduced motion in KDE Plasma.

Comprehensive evolution: Power Profiles Daemon (PPD) interactive quick-switcher and throttling diagnosis, Wi-Fi link telemetry and causal degradation rules, ZRAM compression and cgroup v2 slice memory attribution, Smart Flight Recorder automated incident bookmarks with interactive HTML export, KDE 6 Glass and Accent Glows styling across desktop app and widget, and complete Swedish localization.

Development stabilization of measurement quality, multi-GPU diagnosis, collector recovery, persistent history and session compatibility. Process inspection is read-only, with process management delegated to KDE System Monitor. Physical hardware and desktop qualification remain separate from automated checks.

Major Daily-Driver Release: robust single-instance D-Bus lifecycle, collector auto-reconnect with exponential backoff, logind sleep/resume recovery, dedicated Settings and Preferences Hub, persistent opt-in SQLite WAL telemetry history with trends visualization, system tray integration with live telemetry tooltip and quick actions, safe process termination with UID and PID recycling verification, native Swedish localization (ki18n), and comprehensive accessibility refinements.

Comprehensive UI/UX overhaul: structured modern KDE Plasma 6 interface, responsive navigation tabs, column-aligned process table, polished storage and network telemetry cards, streamlined incident action workflow, and refined Plasmoid widget.
Shared user-session collection, incident investigations and saved local sessions, full process inspection, per-device storage and network metrics, and multiple GPU and battery support.
